units.source_text: 当时风俗：除夕家家赶鬼。

en.t: At that time, the custom was for every household to drive out demons on New Year's Eve.

units.source_text: 命一个人扮作疫病鬼，其他许多人用各种器物发出响声，将鬼赶走，

en.t: They would have one person dress up as a plague demon, while many others made noise with various objects to drive the demon away,
which was said to ensure the household's safety and well-being in the coming year.
